human_approvals.note: `required` and `obtained` are the 8.12-mandated fields and are now populated; an earlier revision left both empty while the prose beneath named four outstanding sign-offs, so an automated consumer -- or a reviewer skimming the mandated field name -- read 'no approvals required' (second review, M3). They record two DIFFERENT things and the distinction is load-bearing. `obtained` holds DECISION RULINGS: answers the owner gave in-session to explicit questions naming the alternatives, authorizing the decisions the ADRs record. `required` holds ROLE-SCOPED SIGN-OFFS: reviews of the resulting artifacts, of which NONE has been performed. The owner holds every role (docs/00-meta/authority-index.md), so both statements are true at once -- but a ruling on a question is not a review of a diff.
